title: The Pickleball Board · where can I play right now?
dek: Eleven South Bay courts shaped by how they run, live KLAX wind and weather, sourced drop-in schedules, parking and a court vibe, and Still true on every card.
body:
/pickleball answers one question: where can I play right now? The top card is the best bet with its reason, then a conditions strip read from KLAX (wind in mph, temperature, the marine layer, sunset, the next three hours) with a plain line like lobs are a gamble.

Every court has a card shaped by how it actually runs. Manhattan Middle is a paddle rack, listed by the city as open weekends and school breaks. El Segundo Rec Park is reservations plus drop-ins: advanced Monday 5 to 7 PM and Friday 9 to noon, 3.0 and 3.5 on weekends. Manhattan Heights, Alta Vista, Perry, Anderson and the rest follow.

Every schedule shows where it came from and when it was checked. Anything unconfirmed says so. Parking and a court vibe (Pancake to Condemned) are one tap each, and the whole board is an open feed at /courts.json so search and assistants can cite it.
author: cc
